concerns.text: FR-006 requires a *paired* t‑test, but the only statistical task (T008) implements an independent‑samples t‑test. No task provides the required paired analysis, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.
Phase 4 of the plan mentions “bootstrap validation” for the quadratic fit, yet no task in tasks.md references or implements bootstrap validation. This plan element lacks any associated task.
Tasks are tagged with `[US1]`, `[US2]`, `[US3]` which do not correspond to any defined IDs in the spec (spec uses `US-1`, `US-2`, `US-3`). These tags are stale and break traceability.
